title: Bruges for Beginners: An Introductory Walking Tour
description: An introduction to Bruges, starting on the Markt below the belfry and following the old merchants’ routes past the Burg and the canals, ending at the Minnewater lake by the old city walls.

title: The Magic of Bruges: A Guide to its Legends and Hidden Treasures
place: Statue of Jan Breydel and Pieter de Coninck, Markt
description: A walk from the Markt past the main sights and into the alleys, courtyards, and hidden gardens around them, with the city’s legends along the way. It ends back near the start, on the Burg.

title: Unknown Bruges Walking Tour: A Journey to the Heart of the Medieval Metropole
place: Statue of Jan Breydel and Pieter de Coninck, Markt
description: A walk away from the crowds, from the Markt past the old merchants’ exchange and into the quiet St. Anna quarter, ending at a windmill on the old ramparts.
